description: Defines the BrokerClient class for message exchange with a transport process, including event handler setup, subscription, configuration, and message forwarding methods.

classes.name: BrokerClient
classes.description: An interface class for a client component that exchanges CMDU messages with a transport process, handling subscriptions, configurations, and message forwarding.

methods.name: set_handlers
methods.description: Sets event handler functions for CMDU reception and connection closure events.

methods.name: clear_handlers
methods.description: Clears all previously set event handler functions.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to specific CMDU message types for reception.

methods.name: configure_interfaces
methods.description: Configures network interfaces and bridges for the transport process.

methods.name: configure_al_mac
methods.description: Configures the MAC address of the bridge in the transport process.

methods.name: configure_primary_vlan_id
methods.description: Sets the primary VLAN ID in the transport process.

methods.name: send_cmdu
methods.description: Sends a CMDU message to the transport process.

methods.name: forward_cmdu
methods.description: Forwards a received CMDU message to the transport process.

methods.name: notify_cmdu_received
methods.description: Internal method to trigger the CMDU received event handler.

methods.name: notify_connection_closed
methods.description: Internal method to trigger the connection closed event handler.
